integrity: The analytic statement is supported by an exact strong-Markov factorization and a 2x2 Markov-renewal identity. Standalone symbolic and independent finite-difference checks are provided; numerical tests are not substitutes for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Stationary two-state gate, 1D reflected Brownian half-line, Poisson position resets, threshold and accumulated open-state local time refreshed at every reset; not valid for retained contact progress. Result concerns means only. Instantaneous open-gate special-case comparison was established in arXiv:2107.02148; only threshold-law universality is assessed as additional. Independent priority/audit not performed.
title: A universal gate-memory delay independent of surface-reaction thresholds
